Original text of the Shennong Bencao Jing [本經]: Gentian [龍膽], flavor bitter, cold. It mainly treats cold and heat between the bones, fright epilepsy and evil qi, continues severed damage, settles the five viscera, and kills gu poison [蠱毒].
